The '''Adasca BioMechanical facility''' was a facility of [[The Adasca BioMechanical Corporation of Arkania]] located on [[Quesh]] during the [[Quesh war]]. During the [[Galactic War]], the facility was used by the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Juns Seros]] in preparing a trap for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] that became [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]]. They did this by offering a legitimate deal where they offered credits in exchange for the hunter sponsoring their new line of [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]] on Quesh. The bounty hunter arrived at the facility and was met by the Director of Public Relations who was actually an SIS agent in disguise. In the resulting shot-out, the hunter and his companion killed every SIS agent present.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Adasca BioMechanical facility appears as an area on Quesh in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
